name: Beli (South Sudan)
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Only Evans-Pritchard 1937 ethnographic note and survey wordlists found; no phonological description located.

sources.citation: Stirtz, Timothy M. 2014. 'Bëlï Phonology, Tone and Orthography. SIL Electronic Working Papers 2014-002. Dallas: SIL International. 34 pp.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or at Harvard
sources.note: Nothing: no section or sentence on stress/accent/prominence (0 hits; only 'acute accent' as a rejected orthographic device). Sec. 3 (p. 6): syllables almost all CV, no consonant or vowel sequences, no contrastive length. Sec. 4 (p. 7): three underlying level tones (H, M, L) plus contours; 'The syllable is the tone-bearing unit.' Secs 6.x: extensive tonal morphophonology and grammatical tone. Wulu dialect.

sources.citation: Kol, Deng Gideon; Matuek, John Majok; Mawuor, Zechariah Manyiel; Mberu, Peter Tiu; Moli, Mbio Nelson; Manyang, Charles Mayen. 2013. 'Bëlï Grammar Book. 1st ed. Juba: SIL-South Sudan. 106 pp.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or at Harvard
sources.note: Zero occurrences of stress/accent; spelling-rule chapter restates the Long Vowel Rule for rising/falling tone; glossary defines tone (pitch) H, M, L; question vs statement distinguished by tone. Nothing on word stress.

sources.citation: 'Bëlï Translation and Literacy Project (Gideon et al.). 2013. Reading and Writing 'Bëlï Book 2. Juba: SIL-South Sudan. 75 pp.
sources.note: Literacy primer: syllables ('beats'), heavy/light (ATR) vowels, tone (High/Low/Mid, rising, falling) and the long-vowel-for-contour-tone spelling rule; no mention of stress or accent.

sources.citation: Gideon [Kol], Deng and Majok [Matuek], John. 2013. 'Bëlï Dictionary (Beli-English). Juba: SIL-South Sudan. 30 pp.
sources.note: Entries carry tone letters (H, M, L per syllable); no stress marking or statement.

sources.citation: Stirtz, Tim. 2013. 'Bëlï Phonology (write-up posted on the Webonary 'Bëlï dictionary site, March 2013; 26 pp; earlier version of SIL e-WP 2014-002).
sources.note: Same content as Stirtz 2014; no mention of stress or accent.

sources.citation: Boyeldieu, Pascal. Présentation / Lexique comparatif sara-bongo-baguirmien (24 pp. intro document; already on file under sarr1246).
sources.note: Comparative-historical; lists 'beli data as from Santandrea 1963; nothing on accent in 'beli.

sources.citation: Cheung, Yuen Wah. 2019. Discourse features: Rendering a Greek Luke Narrative Text into 'Bëlï. MA thesis, Dallas International University.
